entries.04857d49067b2ea6: The business designs, builds and operates facilities for treating solid waste such as refuse incineration. The main products listed in the securities report are municipal waste incineration plants, industrial waste incineration plants and water treatment plants, and the company provides engineering and construction work for design, procurement and construction (EPC), as well as plant operation management and maintenance (O&M). The business is carried out by Ebara Environmental Plant Co., Ltd., Ebara Environmental Engineering (China) Co., Ltd., and the equity-method joint-controlled company Suidō Ing Co., Ltd., in which the company holds 33.3% of the voting rights; Suidō Ing Co., Ltd. also manufactures and sells chemicals in addition to operation and maintenance. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥97,864 million (¥87,438 million in the previous fiscal year, an 11.9% increase year on year), and segment profit was ¥13,003 million (¥8,445 million in the previous fiscal year, a 54.0% increase year on year). Orders received were ¥135,392 million (¥71,594 million in the previous fiscal year, an 89.1% increase year on year), order backlog was ¥384,675 million, and the number of employees was 2,830. The company cites as reasons for the increase in revenue the receipt of four large-scale orders for life extension and renovation of waste treatment facilities, an increase in O&M, and an improvement in profitability.
entries.23b437f8dc176e17: Custom pumps (agricultural pumps, drainage pumps, sewage and water supply pumps)
entries.5266f23130e94618: The business supplies machinery for the oil and gas, power and new energy sectors. The main products listed in the securities report are custom pumps, compressors, turbines, cryopumps and expanders. Manufacturing, sales and maintenance are handled by the company itself, together with EBARA ELLIOTT SERVICES, INC. in Japan, and overseas by Elliott Company (United States), Jialite Ebara Pump Industry Co., Ltd. and Ebara Machinery Zibo Co., Ltd. (China), and Elliott Ebara Singapore Pte. Ltd. (Singapore). Elliott Company is separately disclosed by the securities report with its main profit and loss information, as it accounts for more than 10% of consolidated revenue excluding internal transactions (revenue including internal transactions was ¥130,438 million). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥217,845 million (¥210,434 million in the previous fiscal year, a 3.5% increase year on year), the third largest after Building & Industrial. Segment profit, on the other hand, was ¥25,943 million (¥28,008 million in the previous fiscal year, a 7.4% decrease year on year), with profit falling mainly due to an increase in fixed costs. Orders received were ¥194,777 million (¥222,743 million in the previous fiscal year, a 12.6% decrease year on year), order backlog was ¥213,790 million, and the number of employees was 3,585. The company explains that orders fell below the previous year due to a decline in petrochemical projects and reduced field services and parts, while revenue increased because Service & Support was solid in the Middle East and Asia.
entries.6112afcaac29e882: The business supplies pumps for water infrastructure (water-related facilities that support society). The main products listed in the securities report are custom pumps (agricultural pumps, drainage pumps, sewage and water supply pumps) and tunnel blowers; manufacturing, sales, operation and maintenance are handled by the company itself and Ebara Densan Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥57,143 million (¥51,118 million in the previous fiscal year, an 11.8% increase year on year), the smallest of the five reportable segments. Segment profit was ¥4,680 million (¥3,697 million in the previous fiscal year, a 26.6% increase year on year), orders received were ¥62,973 million (a 4.0% increase year on year), order backlog was ¥83,453 million, and the number of employees was 1,581. The company cites solid demand for renewal and repair in the domestic public pump market, large-scale orders received in South America and North America overseas, and steady progress in working off the order backlog.
entries.aca14db34153f3d5: A machinery manufacturer headquartered in Ota Ward, Tokyo, handling everything from pumps and compressors to semiconductor manufacturing equipment and waste incineration plants.
entries.bbd56090ac51e6ab: A business providing equipment and components for factories that make semiconductors, and the largest segment at Ebara. The main products listed in the securities report are vacuum pumps, CMP equipment (equipment that polishes and flattens the surface of a [[term:wafer|wafer]]), plating equipment and exhaust gas treatment equipment, and the main end market (customer field) is semiconductor manufacturing. The company handles manufacturing and sales, while Ebara Field Tech Co., Ltd., Ebara Technologies Inc., Shanghai Ebara Precision Machinery Co., Ltd., Ebara Precision Machinery Korea Inc., Taiwan Ebara Precision Machinery Co., Ltd., and Ebara Precision Machinery Europe GmbH handle sales and after-sales service. Production and development of [[term:semiconductor-manufacturing-equipment|semiconductor manufacturing equipment]] and vacuum pumps are handled at the Fujisawa Business Site in Kanagawa Prefecture, and production of semiconductor manufacturing equipment is handled at the Kumamoto Business Site in Kumamoto Prefecture. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, external customer revenue was ¥342,267 million (prior year ¥278,378 million, up 23.0% year on year), the largest of the 5 reportable segments. Segment profit was ¥57,773 million (prior year ¥50,133 million), orders received were ¥303,447 million (up 16.7% year on year), and the number of employees was 4,000. The company explains that demand for CMP and components recovered, and that both products and service & support exceeded the previous year. The filing also states that while customers' factory utilization rates continue to recover, centered on demand for generative AI, the full-scale resumption of capacity-expansion investment is later than initially expected.
entries.bcb26c7062b91b6c: The business supplies pumps and air-conditioning and cooling machinery used in building equipment and industrial facilities. The main products listed in the securities report are standard pumps (land pumps, submersible pumps, water supply pumps), refrigeration and heat-related machinery, and blowers. Manufacturing, sales and maintenance are handled by the company itself, together with EBARA REFRIGERATION & AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEMS, INC. and EBARA WIND ENERGY MACHINERY, INC. in Japan, and overseas by EBARA BOMBAS AMÉRICA DO SUL LTDA. (Brazil), Ebara Pumps Europe S.p.A. (Italy), EBARA PUMPS IBERIA, S.A. (Spain), Ebara Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Systems (China) Co., Ltd. and Ebara Machinery (China) Co., Ltd. (China), Ebara Engineering Singapore Pte. Ltd. (Singapore), Vansan Makina Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. (Turkey), and EBARA HG Holdings Inc. and EBARA PUMPS AMERICAS CORPORATION (United States). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥241,938 million (¥238,182 million in the previous fiscal year, a 1.6% increase year on year), the second largest after Precision & Electronics. Segment profit was ¥15,251 million (¥10,341 million in the previous fiscal year), and orders received were ¥249,285 million (a 2.0% increase year on year); with 7,654 employees, it has the largest workforce of the five reportable segments. The company explains that in Japan, Service & Support performed well, and overseas, China was weak while North America's data center demand and the Middle East and Europe were solid. The company also cites the absence of the goodwill impairment loss recorded in the previous year related to Vansan (consolidated goodwill impairment loss of ¥7,085 million) as a reason for the increase in profit.
entries.d631d624f5fef4e8: This is the category the securities report calls "business segments not included in reportable segments," and it contains regional holding companies and similar entities. The company listed under business description is Ebara (China) Co., Ltd., the regional holding company in China (a specified subsidiary with 100.0% of voting rights). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,225 million (¥1,115 million in the previous fiscal year), and segment loss was ¥2,294 million (a loss of ¥2,826 million in the previous fiscal year), a small category relative to the consolidated total. The securities report prints the number of employees as 1,498 under "Other / Corporate," and this is not the number for this category alone.
